pages.title: Harbor Drake
pages.html:
Harbor Drake

A cove-dwelling drake that shadows fishing boats — usually a nuisance, sometimes worse.

TypeDragon (drake)
SizeLarge
HabitatSea caves near Silverhaven
ThreatModerate
DietFish, and the occasional net

The Harbor Drake is a sleek, salt-scarred cousin of true dragons, no bigger than a rowboat. It trails fishing craft for easy meals and sulks in the cliff caves outside Silverhaven.

Behavior

Territorial but rarely deadly — it prefers theft to a fight. A drake that has tasted cargo, though, grows bold enough to raid the wharves.

Sightings & Lore

Dockworkers blame every missing crate on "the drake." Some of the time, they're right.

🔒 Not yet unlocked

pages.title: Mira Voss
pages.html:
Mira Voss

Harbormaster of Silverhaven, and the first friendly face most travelers meet.

RaceHuman
OccupationHarbormaster
HomeSilverhaven
AffiliationSilverhaven Harbor Guild

Mira Voss runs the docks of Silverhaven with a ledger in one hand and a grappling hook in the other. Sailors trust her word more than most contracts.

Description

Weathered, sharp-eyed, and never without her harbor whistle. She's quick to laugh but quicker to notice a ship riding low in the water.

History

Born to a fishing family on the Argent Coast, Mira worked her way up from deckhand to harbormaster over twenty years — she knows every captain who's ever docked here.

🔒 Not yet unlocked

Around the Docks

Passive Perception15
LanguagesCommon, Aquan
Usually CarryingHarbor whistle, ledger, cutlass

pages.title: Silverhaven Harbor Guild
pages.html:
Silverhaven Harbor Guild

The guild that runs the docks, sets the tariffs, and knows every cargo that moves.

LeaderMira Voss
HeadquartersSilverhaven
FoundedTwo centuries ago
MembershipDockworkers, pilots, chandlers
ReachEvery wharf on the Argent Coast

The Silverhaven Harbor Guild licenses every pilot, weighs every cargo, and collects the harbor tariff that keeps the lighthouse lit. If a ship docks at Silverhaven, the Guild has a record of it.

Structure

Apprentices work the wharves; licensed pilots guide ships past the reef; the harbormaster speaks for them all.

Standing

Broadly trusted, occasionally resented for its tariffs — but no one questions that the Guild keeps the harbor safe.

🔒 Not yet unlocked

pages.title: Tideglass Lantern
pages.html:
Tideglass Lantern

A lantern of blue-green glass that burns without oil and never gutters in a storm.

RarityUncommon
AttunementNo
TypeWondrous Item
Current OwnerMira Voss
OriginRecovered from The Sunken Temple

The Tideglass Lantern is carved from a single pane of blue-green tideglass. Its flame holds steady through gale and downpour, and sailors swear it points the way home.

Powers

While lit, the lantern sheds steady light no wind can extinguish, and its glow turns a deeper blue as danger nears the water.

History

Pulled from the flooded halls of The Sunken Temple, it now hangs at the Silverhaven harbor gate. The faithful call it a gift of Ymara.

🔒 Not yet unlocked

pages.title: Silverhaven
pages.html:
Silverhaven

A bustling port city on the Argent Coast, famous for silver and its great lighthouse.

RegionThe Argent Coast
Population~4,000
GovernmentMerchant council
HarbormasterMira Voss
Patron DeityYmara

Silverhaven is a bustling port city on the Argent Coast, famous for its silver trade and towering lighthouse. Its harbor is run by Mira Voss, a steady hand who's seen every ship the tide has brought in.

History

Founded centuries ago by sailors fleeing a sunken homeland, Silverhaven grew rich on the silver veins in the nearby cliffs. The Silverhaven Harbor Guild has watched over its docks ever since.

🔒 Not yet unlocked

To the south, beneath the waves, lies The Sunken Temple.

pages.title: The Sunken Temple
pages.html:
The Sunken Temple rests on the seabed south of Silverhaven, its drowned halls lit by an eerie blue glow.

Adventurers speak of a sealed vault at its heart, though none have returned to confirm it.

pages.title: The Sundering Tide
pages.html:
The Sundering Tide

The night the sea rose and swallowed a temple whole — remembered in every harbor hymn.

EraThe Drowning Age
When~300 years ago
WhereSilverhaven
ConsequenceBirth of The Sunken Temple

What Happened

Three centuries past, a single monstrous tide rose over the Argent Coast in one night. When it drew back, a whole temple and the headland it stood on were simply gone beneath the waves — what sailors now call The Sunken Temple.

Aftermath

Survivors founded Silverhaven on higher ground and swore their offerings to Ymara. The Tidemother's cult dates its calendar from that night.

pages.title: The Night Ledger
pages.html:
The Night Ledger

Mira Voss will trust the party with a dangerous secret — if they prove worthy first.

StatusActive
GiverMira Voss
RewardThe night-log, and a friend at the docks
LocationSilverhaven

Summary

Mira Voss has noticed ships unloading at Silverhaven's wharves after dark, off the books. She keeps a private ledger of them — but she won't share it with strangers.

Objectives

  • Earn Mira's trust around the harbor.
  • Learn who is smuggling cargo past the Silverhaven Harbor Guild.

Leads

Ask the dockworkers. Watch the far wharf at night. Notice which manifests don't add up.

🔒 Not yet unlocked

pages.title: Ymara, the Tidemother
pages.html:
Ymara, the Tidemother

Goddess of tides and safe harbors, watched for in every wave along the Argent Coast.

DomainSea, Storms, Safe Harbor
SymbolA cresting silver wave
WorshippersSailors, fishers, harbor folk
Holy DayThe first storm of autumn
Seat of WorshipSilverhaven

Ymara, the Tidemother is the sea given a face — generous with calm waters, terrible when slighted. Every ship leaving Silverhaven pours a cup over the rail for her.

Worship

Her shrines stand at harbor mouths, hung with lanterns and knotted rope. Offerings are simple: fresh water, a coin, a promise kept.

Tenets

  • Guide those who are lost back to shore.
  • Take nothing from the sea you will not return.
🔒 Not yet unlocked

pages.title: Session 1 — Arrival at Silverhaven
pages.html:
Session 1 — Arrival at Silverhaven

The party made landfall, met the harbormaster, and caught wind of trouble on the docks.

Session1
In-World DateFirst storm of autumn
LocationSilverhaven

Recap

The party sailed into Silverhaven ahead of the season's first storm and were met at the wharf by Mira Voss. Over dinner she mentioned — carefully — that ships had been unloading after dark without the Silverhaven Harbor Guild's seal.

Loot & Rewards

  • A warm meal and lodging, courtesy of the harbormaster.
  • A standing invitation to look into The Night Ledger.

Hooks for Next Time

  • Who is smuggling cargo past the Guild?
  • What did the fishers mean about "the drake" in the coves?
